title: Mitoquinone Prevents Cardiac Dysfunction by Normalizing Mitochondrial ROS and Calcium Handling in Acute Myocardial Infarction.
design: preclinical animal study (rat acute myocardial infarction model)

outcomes.name: hemodynamic parameters
outcomes.effect_text: significantly improved hemodynamic parameters compared to the Infarct group

outcomes.name: inotropic response to extracellular Ca2+ (papillary muscle)
outcomes.effect_text: restored the inotropic response to extracellular Ca2+

outcomes.name: total and mitochondrial superoxide (O2•-) production
outcomes.effect_text: significantly decreased total and mitochondrial O2•- production
